jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a GIS Specialist – Production to support a mission\-focused GIS Service Center delivering enterprise geospatial products, services, and technical support. This role is responsible for production coordination, quality control, database/map product release, vendor coordination, and enterprise workflow support, while working closely with the Service Center Manager and broader GIS team to maintain a reliable GIS operating environment.
***\*Please note, this is not a traditional full‑time position. It is a deployment‑based, on\-call position. Team members must be located near Sacramento, CA.****﻿*The projected range for this position is $40 to $50 hourly. Depending upon other factors, i.e., skills, experience, location, market conditions, the range may vary slightly. These ranges are for CA only.
Responsibilities**Production Coordination \& Quality Control*** Implement and manage quality control (QC) procedures to ensure deliverables meet established standards for accuracy, completeness, and usability.
* Oversee procedures performed by associate specialists and technicians to ensure consistent production methods and adherence to workflows.
* Approve and release final product databases, maps, and reports when delegated by the Service Center Manager.
* Work independently on assigned production tasks while contributing effectively within an interdisciplinary GIS team supporting enterprise and regional priorities.

**Enterprise Workflow \& Database Support*** Perform mapping and database management functions across multiple project types and operational needs.
* Create and maintain schemas and workflow procedures that support enterprise GIS operations and repeatable production.
* Monitor and help ensure proper data backups and sound data stewardship practices.

**Operations Support \& Vendor Coordination*** Coordinate with hardware/software vendors to support a stable, problem\-free operating environment.
* Assist the Service Center Manager with user and project setup, accounting, and security activities as needed for operational readiness.
* Support management and use of data collection technologies to meet program needs.

**Required Skills \& Required Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in natural sciences, engineering, computer sciences, geography/GIS, or related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience).
* Demonstrated working knowledge of the Esri platform, including ArcGIS Pro and common extensions (e.g., Spatial Analyst), with solid cartography and production mapping skills.
* 3\+ years of experience with Python and/or ModelBuilder supporting GIS automation and production workflows.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, follow established procedures, and deliver accurate products under schedule requirements (consistent with production/QC responsibilities).
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity and production QC.
* Practical understanding of enterprise GIS operations, repeatable workflows, and controlled data releases.
* Effective communicator who can coordinate with technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with ArcGIS Server and enterprise geodatabase configurations (e.g., ArcSDE) and/or similar enterprise GIS technologies.
* Experience with ArcGIS Online administration (content management, users/roles, governance).
* Recent completion (within \~2 years) of relevant Esri training such as ArcGIS Pro, geodatabases, cartographic production, 3D/visualization, or field workflow modernization (may substitute for some experience per contract guidance).

**Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to pass a driving record background check.**

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consulting GIS Specialist – Service Center Manager and Site Supervisor/Application Developer to lead delivery of enterprise geospatial services in support of federal clients. This position provides technical leadership, operational management, and advanced GIS application development for a multi\-disciplinary GIS Service Center supporting mission\-critical geospatial programs. The successful candidate will oversee staff, manage enterprise GIS infrastructure, and develop custom applications that support data\-driven decision\-making across water resources, environmental compliance, land management, and infrastructure programs.
***\*Please note, this is not a traditional full‑time position. It is a deployment‑based, on\-call position. Team members must be located near Sacramento, CA.****﻿*The projected range for this position is $45 to $65 hourly. Depending upon other factors, i.e., skills, experience, location, market conditions, the range may vary slightly. These ranges are for CA only.
Responsibilities**Service Center Leadership \& Operations*** Manage day\-to\-day operations of the GIS Service Center, including workload planning, staffing, scheduling, and performance oversight
* Supervise GIS specialists, developers, and technicians; assign tasks and monitor production quality, schedule adherence, and deliverable completeness
* Provide administrative oversight including coordination of staffing, training, travel, and resource planning
* Ensure compliance with client policies, standards, security requirements, and enterprise GIS governance
* Prepare and deliver status reports, management reports, and performance metrics to stakeholders

**nterprise GIS \& Systems Management*** Oversee administration and maintenance of enterprise GIS systems, including ArcGIS Enterprise, cloud environments, and geospatial databases
* Ensure system availability, performance, security, backup, and disaster recovery
* Coordinate with IT teams on system architecture, upgrades, configurations, and integration
* Maintain integrity, accessibility, and lifecycle management of enterprise geospatial data

**Application Development \& Technical Delivery*** Lead design and development of custom GIS applications, tools, and workflows using ESRI technologies and modern programming frameworks
* Develop web\-based GIS solutions, dashboards, and data services using platforms such as ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise
* Build automation tools and analytical models to support geospatial workflows and decision\-making
* Integrate GIS with external systems, environmental models, and enterprise data platforms

**Geospatial Analysis \& Program Support*** Provide advanced geospatial analysis, modeling, and visualization to support programs such as:
* Water resource management and modeling
* Land use and land ownership analysis
* Environmental compliance (e.g., ESA, NEPA)
* Emergency response and flood inundation mapping
* Support development of maps, reports, dashboards, and analytical products

**Client Support, Training \& Collaboration*** Serve as primary point of contact for GIS technical support and user engagement
* Provide help desk support and troubleshooting for GIS applications and systems
* Develop and deliver training for end users on GIS tools, workflows, and data management
* Collaborate with planners, engineers, scientists, and IT staff to deliver integrated solutions

**Strategic Planning \& Innovation*** Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies and recommend enhancements to improve service delivery
* Forecast workload, staffing needs, and infrastructure requirements
* Support continuous improvement of GIS services, workflows, and enterprise capabilities

**Required Skills \& Required Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8\+ years of progressive GIS experience, including enterprise GIS and application development
* 3\+ years of experience in a supervisory or team leadership role
* ESRI platform expertise (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online)
* Programming experience in one or more of:
* Python
* JavaScript (APIs, web mapping)
* C\#, .NET, or similar
* Experience with:
* Geospatial database design and management (e.g., SQL Server, ArcSDE)
* Web GIS development and deployment
* Cloud or hybrid GIS architectures
* Data automation and geoprocessing workflows
* Leadership and team management
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving
* Technical depth in GIS systems and development
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to obtain and maintain federal security clearance (e.g., NAC/NACI)
* Occasional travel for client meetings, training, or field coordination

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience supporting federal clients or large\-scale geospatial programs
* Knowledge of water resources, environmental science, or land management applications
* Familiarity with remote sensing, GPS data collection, and modeling tools (e.g., hydrologic models)
* Experience integrating GIS with external systems or enterprise applications
* Relevant GIS certifications (e.g., GISP) or ESRI technical certifications

**Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to pass a driving record background check.**

Job Description: **Position Overview**


This position will design and implement appropriate technical services to ensure that client and project management needs are met. Position includes performing field and office tasks as well as providing project management support for traditional assessment and remediation projects.


**Position Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in relevant technical field.
* Minimum of 4 years in the environmental consulting industry with demonstrated progression in technical site investigation / remediation and task management.
* Proficient in designing field programs and managing projects and associated field activities – scheduling, coordination of tasks, budgeting, subcontractor negotiating/management.
* Experience planning, coordinating, and managing Site/Remedial Investigation field activities and performing follow up intermediate hydrogeologic and data interpretation.
* Demonstrated task/project management skills.
* Intermediate data evaluation and analytical skills.
* Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with common technical protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Ability and willingness to support the technical growth of staff level professionals based on direct hands\-on interactions.

  




**Essential Duties**


* Field Coordination and Management:
	+ Set up work plans and protocols, supervise field activities, coordinate field personnel and related activities for the purpose of implementing technically sound project plans. May also include implementation of field activities.
* Technical Data Review and Report Preparation:
	+ Coordinate the collection and review of project data, including the reduction of field data to evaluate and determine future client needs and project requirements. Interpret data, develop, and finalize a report for Project Manager’s review that appropriately documents findings and project remediation recommendations.
* Project Management:
	+ Ensure that individual task schedules, budgets, and client invoicing are monitored and reviewed in compliance with Company standards and client requirements to complete project work.
* Staff Mentoring and Training:
	+ Participate in the development of junior staff and work with senior management to continue to grow as a consultant and leader of the firm.

**Physical Demands/Work Environment Conditions**


This position works in the field as well as the office environment. In the field, candidate will be working independently or leading a larger team at exterior project sites (i.e., industrial/brownfield facilities, monitoring wells, treatment systems, construction projects) to perform sample collection, recording of operational/meter parameters, and oversight of subcontractors (e.g., drillers, heavy equipment operators, truckers). These field activities require the ability to drive to different project sites and physically move around outdoors in various terrains, in adverse weather conditions and occasionally for extended or irregular hours. Conducting work involves the use of hand\-held monitoring instruments and tools, as well as water sampling equipment, which requires the ability to routinely lift and carry objects, stand, walk, reach, bend, squat, kneel and twist. Office work is primarily stationary/sedentary using a computer and keyboard/mouse requiring repetitive hand movements.

*Roux will take steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the position, please contact* *HR@rouxinc.com**.*

  

Base Salary Range: $85,000 \- $115,000\. This salary range is based on what Roux in good faith believes it might pay at the time of posting for this position and for this geographic location. Actual compensation may vary based on job\-related factors such as relevant work experience, market conditions, education/training, certifications, skill sets, and internal equity. jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


In addition to the current opening, this recruitment may be used to establish a pool of qualified candidates to fill future Snoqualmie (WRIA 7\) Project Coordinator (Project/Program Manager III) positions throughout the Department of Natural Resources \& Parks (DNRP) over the next six (6\) months.  

Are you passionate about restoring salmon habitat, protecting our watersheds, and bringing people together to solve complex environmental challenges? King County's Water and Land Resources Division is seeking a collaborative, action\-oriented Project Coordinator to help lead salmon recovery efforts in the Snoqualmie and South Fork Skykomish watersheds.


In this highly collaborative role, you'll work with Tribes, local governments, community organizations, state and federal agencies, and other partners to advance habitat restoration projects, administer grant funding, and develop strategies that protect one of the region's most important natural resources. If you enjoy building partnerships, managing meaningful projects, and turning science into action, we encourage you to apply.

**About the Role**
As the Snoqualmie (WRIA 7\) Project Coordinator, you will coordinate the planning, funding, and implementation of salmon habitat protection and restoration projects throughout the King County portion of the Snoqualmie and South Fork Skykomish watersheds.


This position serves as a key liaison among local, tribal, state, federal, and nonprofit partners, helping move complex, multi\-year restoration projects from concept to completion.
